description: Search USPTO ex parte Appeals decisions — an applicant's appeal of a patent examiner's rejection to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board. This is a SEPARATE docket from AIA trials (IPR/PGR/CBM/derivation): an appeal number looks like "2024-001234", not "IPR2024-00001". Returns an outcome-count summary first (affirmed / reversed / affirmed-in-part / other), then the matching decision records, each with the applicant/real-party-in-interest, application and patent number, counsel, art unit, appeal filing date, decision type/date, and the decision document link. Filter by `appeal_number`, `application_number` (the rejected application under appeal), free-text `query`, and/or a `decided_after`/`decided_before` date range. Powered by the USPTO Open Data Portal (data.uspto.gov).

_apiKey.description: USPTO ODP API key (same key as the patents/uspto-ptab packs). Get free at https://data.uspto.gov/apis/getting-started.

appeal_number.description: Optional. Ex parte appeal number, e.g. "2024-001234" (with or without an "Appeal" prefix). This is NOT an AIA trial number.

application_number.description: Optional. The patent application number under appeal, e.g. "16123456".

decided_after.description: Optional. Only decisions on/after this date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

decided_before.description: Optional. Only decisions on/before this date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

include_raw.description: Optional, default false. When true, also return raw_sample: one UNMODIFIED raw record exactly as the upstream API returned it (no field renaming), to verify or correct this tool's field mapping.

limit.description: Number of decision records to return (1-100, default 25). Outcome counts are computed over this same page.

query.description: Optional free-text keyword search across appeal decision records (e.g. a technology term or applicant name).

name: ptab_search_appeals
title: Ptab Search Appeals
